'''Tidal breathing''' was a relaxation techniques taught to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] by her master [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]]. By concentrating on exhaling deeply, relaxing and drawing a deep breath, then repeating the actions, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could shed mental burdens and reach a deeper, more receptive state of mind. This allowed them to make an intense connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], becoming a conduit for it's power.
